prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t say one single lawyer is the absolute “best” for every truck accident—best depends on the facts of your case and who has the right experience and resources for it. I can, however, tell you how to find the top Dallas attorney for a truck crash and help shortlist candidates if you want.

Immediate practical steps (if you haven’t already)
- Get medical treatment and keep records.  
- Report the crash to police and get the crash report number.  
- Preserve evidence: photos of vehicles, scene, injuries; witness names/contacts; video if available.  
- Don’t give recorded statements to insurers or sign releases without a lawyer.  
- Note truck identifiers: company name, DOT number, license plate, driver name.  
- Be aware: in Texas the general personal-injury statute of limitations is 2 years from the accident date.

What to look for in a truck-accident lawyer
- Specific trucking experience: FMCSA rules, black-box/ECM data, logbooks, hours-of-service, cargo/maintenance issues, subcontractor structures.  
- Record of significant settlements/verdicts in truck cases (not just general car crashes).  
- Trial experience and resources—truck cases often involve large companies/insurers and need investigators/experts.  
- Board certification or recognition: e.g., Texas Board of Legal Specialization (Personal Injury Trial Law), Martindale-Hubbell AV ratings, Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers.  
- Contingency-fee arrangements and clear explanation of costs and expenses.  
- Good communication, availability, and client references.

Questions to ask in a free consultation
- How many truck accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?  
- Have you handled cases against trucking companies/insurers? Any verdicts/settlements you can describe?  
- Will you handle my case personally or a team/associate?  
- Do you have investigators and expert witnesses you use?  
- What is your fee (contingency %) and how are litigation costs handled?  
- What is your assessment of my case and potential timeline?

Where to search and verify credentials
- Dallas Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service  
- Texas Trial Lawyers Association (TTLA) member directory  
- Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers, AVVO, Best Lawyers  
- Texas State Bar (to check discipline/standing)  
- Local reviews and recent case results published by firms

If you want, I can:
- Look up top-rated Dallas truck-accident lawyers/firms and give you a short list (I’ll need your zip code or neighborhood).  
- Draft an email or list of questions to send to attorneys.  
- Help you evaluate responses from lawyers you contact.

Tell me which option you prefer (or give a ZIP code and a brief case summary) and I’ll pull a short, vetted list of Dallas attorneys or help you prepare for consultations.
